Added TextureFromSourceForm + textures.createFromSource() so a human can write PARENA source directly for the NOCK texture generator instead of only editing AI-generated output. Backend pipeline (procgen.go CreateProceduralTexture) unchanged, already tested. Commit IDUNA 8a7d229.
